title: 01 · Upload idempotency
notes: The frontend retains a UUID for the same File object, title and visibility; a reload or new file selection is a new intent. No automatic upload retry loop is implemented. Without a supplied key the server generates a new key for that request. This is request deduplication, not global content deduplication.

title: 03 · Claims, leases and deadlines
notes: No database transaction stays open across media/model work. Lease renewal and publication require both a live lease and a live absolute deadline. Ordinary failure recording checks the matching token and a live lease; expired-work recovery has a separate guarded path. Terminal video status alone does not cancel already pending sibling work.

title: 05 · Retry state and expired-work recovery
notes: Three attempts means three total successful claims, not three extra retries. A fresh Celery message with request.retries == 0 does not reset this budget.
